title: Summary tab: stream, save and regenerate the summary
description: Summarise the session through the LLM, showing tokens as they arrive, and save the result with the session (goal 4).
steps: In `SessionRepository` add `observeMessages(sessionId, kind): Flow<List<ChatMessageEntity>>`, `addMessage(sessionId, kind, role, content): Long`, `clearMessages(sessionId, kind)`.

Create `ui/session/SummaryViewModel.kt`: constructor `(sessionId: Long, repository: SessionRepository, chatClient: ChatClient, settings: SettingsRepository)`. State `data class SummaryUiState(val saved: String? = null, val streaming: String = "", val running: Boolean = false, val error: String? = null, val configured: Boolean = true)`. `saved` = content of the latest ASSISTANT SUMMARY message. `configured` = baseUrl and model not blank. `fun summarise()`: ignore if running; build the transcript text with `TranscriptFormatter` from the repository's segments/speakers; if blank set error "The transcript is empty."; else collect `chatClient.stream(PromptBuilder.summary(text, maxChars))` appending to `streaming`; on completion `clearMessages(SUMMARY)` then `addMessage(SUMMARY, ASSISTANT, full)`, reset streaming/running. On LlmException set `error = message` and keep the old saved summary. `fun cancel()` cancels the job.

In `SessionScreen` replace the Summary tab placeholder: if not configured, text "Set up a language model endpoint in Settings." + button navigating to `settings`. Else: button "Summarise" (or "Regenerate" when a summary is saved), while running show the streaming text + a "Stop" button + small `CircularProgressIndicator`; show the saved summary in a `SelectionContainer` with `bodyLarge`. Show error in error color with "Retry". Add a "Copy" `TextButton` using `LocalClipboardManager` (no ContentCopy icon: it is not in material-icons-core). Render the summary as plain text (no markdown library).
acceptanceCriteria: Test: fake streaming "A","B","C" ends with `saved == "ABC"`, one SUMMARY message in DB, `running == false`
Test: regenerate replaces the previous summary (still exactly one SUMMARY message)
Test: fake throwing LlmException("HTTP 500: x") sets error and keeps the previous saved summary
Test: empty transcript sets error `The transcript is empty.` and never calls the client
Test: the messages sent to the fake equal `PromptBuilder.summary(...)` for the session's transcript
